claude_proposed_widenings.name: character_advancement
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: ASI is a level-up benefit, not an in-game activation. The existing `activation` family requires activationCost + use_count resource + resetCadence + effect — none of which apply. A new ClassFeatureMechanics family is needed for permanent one-time benefits conferred at specific class levels.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You gain the Ability Score Improvement feat (see "Feats") or another feat of your choice for which you qualify. You gain this feature again at Wizard levels 8, 12, and 16.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: modify_ability_score
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The ASI feat permanently modifies ability scores — pre-runtime character state. The v4 taxonomy explicitly defers this atom as out-of-scope ('modify_ability_score as a runtime effect versus as pre-runtime character state — currently treated as out-of-scope'). It is absent from ClassFeatureEffect.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You gain the Ability Score Improvement feat (see "Feats") or another feat of your choice for which you qualify.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: grant_feat
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The feature grants a feat choice (ASI feat or any qualifying feat). No existing ClassFeatureEffect variant represents this. grant_spell_access exists for spells but has no parallel for feats.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You gain the Ability Score Improvement feat (see "Feats") or another feat of your choice for which you qualify.
